admission.justification: Spans history_consolidation.py models and knowledge_writer/row_tests.py enforcement across consolidation passes, guarded by consolidation pass tests.

applicability: Invariant and family history rows authored in a consolidation task.
conditions: Invariant and family rows admit stands and unresolved dispositions only for listed consolidation subjects, with every consolidation task rule row requiring testsRun, testsNotRun (with reason), or noProofRecorded: true.
Adding a missing title to an existing rule leaves its revision unchanged and closes the listed item with stands.
exclusions: Ordinary non-consolidation leaves, where stands and unresolved are not admitted and proof-evidence fields are not required on invariant rows.

evidence: test_consolidation_pass.py and sbx-e8 Evidence 8 SBX-C1-L1/L2 history rows.

statement: Consolidation history rows admit stands and unresolved dispositions and require proof evidence (testsRun, testsNotRun with reason, or noProofRecorded: true) on every rule row of a consolidation task, while title-only additions keep revision unchanged and use stands.
title: Consolidation stands/unresolved rows, proof evidence, and title-only stands
